title: Soup loop iteration record
description: A snapshot of one harvest -> train -> verdict -> canary cycle, appended to .soup-loops/iterations.jsonl (default layout) each time the iteration advances; the latest line per iteration_id wins. Which version is active is NOT read from here but from the version log (version.schema.json). The first deployed model is a seed line: parent_iteration_id and from_version null, to_version 1, outcome promoted. Readers ignore unknown fields.

parent_iteration_id.description: The iteration whose version this one started from; null for the seed line.

from_version.description: The version that was active when the iteration started; null for the seed line.

to_version.description: The version this iteration produces; null when it ended before producing one.

finished_at.description: When the iteration reached a final outcome; null while it is still running or in canary.

until.description: Cursor: conversation and feedback lines with ts up to and including this moment were considered. The next iteration reads only newer lines.

feedback.description: Feedback lines counted after the latest-wins rule.

dataset.description: The training data built from the harvest.

method.description: The Soup training task, e.g. dpo or kto.

base.description: What training actually loaded as its starting point (a base model id, or a merged earlier version's directory).

root_base.description: The original base model id the version line descends from, when base is a merged earlier version.

decision.description: SHIP and DON'T SHIP are soup ship's decisions; SKIPPED and ERROR mean no verdict was reached, and the iteration does not roll out.

baseline.description: What the candidate was compared against.

ref.description: What was loaded as the baseline: a base model id (kind base), or the served name or path of an earlier version (kind version).

version.description: The baseline's version number; required when kind is version.

samples.description: Answers observed per bucket during this canary.

verdict.description: UNKNOWN: too few samples so far.

artifacts.description: What is needed to serve this iteration's version again.

served_as.description: The name the version is served under: a soup serve adapter name, or an Ollama tag such as myproj:v2.

outcome.description: running: not past the verdict yet. canary: serving a share of traffic. promoted: to_version became the active version. rolled_back: the canary was withdrawn. skipped: nothing to train or no verdict reached. failed: a stage errored.

reason.description: Why the iteration has this outcome, in plain words.

^x_[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.description: Producer extension namespace (x_<app>). Soup never reads or rewrites it.

iteration_id.description: Unique, safe as a directory name. soup-cli writes iter-<UTC YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS>-<8 hex>.

utc_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, suffix Z or +00:00.
